title: Tenant lifecycle event (v1)
description: Business/integration event published by tenant-service on the aegis.tenant.lifecycle topic, keyed by tenant slug. Consumed by services that react to tenant lifecycle (e.g. the authorization-server eagerly provisions the tenant signing key on tenant.created). Distinct from audit events (aegis.audit.events).

eventType.description: The lifecycle transition. Consumers ignore types they do not handle.

x-note: Consumers read tolerantly (unknown fields ignored) so the producer can add fields without breaking a rolling deploy. A new required field or a semantic change is a v2 (new schema + parallel topic or a version field), never an edit to v1.
